title: The Ancestor's Shield
text: A shield hangs over a barrow's door, its paint flaking, its rim black with age. Each of you looks up and sees your own House's arms upon it, painted by someone who died before your founders were born. Beneath it the barrow breathes out a cold, patient air, and every House is already sure the shield is theirs.

options.label: Take it down by right of blood, whichever blood that turns out to be.

outcomes.text: It comes down easily, as though it had been waiting. The Houses argue over whose arms it bears for the rest of the day, each still seeing their own.
The ancestor disagrees with every claim. It rises from the barrow to settle the matter.

options.label: Kneel and honor the dead below.

outcomes.text: The cold air warms a little. Something in the barrow is proud of you.

options.label: The wisest reads the barrow's runes, searching for the meaning behind the strange spectacle.

outcomes.text: The runes name a forgotten branch of a House and tell how it ended. They do not say which House; the wisest keeps what they read to themselves.
